recognize_zh: 組織中成片中大型漿細胞樣細胞，核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁；CD79a、CD138 與 IgG 陽性，但 kappa 與 lambda 輕鏈都呈陰性，免疫固定電泳只見 IgG（G）條帶而無對應輕鏈，符合 γ 重鏈病。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval vesicular nuclei, many with a distinct central nucleolus
IHC: CD79a and CD138 positive with cytoplasmic IgG expression
IHC: tumor cells negative for both kappa and lambda light chains (only rare positive reactive cell)
Immunofixation: band in the gamma lane without a matching kappa or lambda band
describe_en: Tissue sections show a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. The neoplastic cells express CD79a, CD138, and cytoplasmic IgG, but are negative for both kappa and lambda light chains, with only rare scattered positive reactive cells. Serum immunofixation electrophoresis shows a monoclonal band in the IgG lane without a corresponding kappa or lambda light chain band. Findings are consistent with gamma heavy chain disease with a plasmacytic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or plasmacytoma (IgG type)
ddx.vs: Conventional IgG myeloma shows monotypic kappa or lambda light chain co-expression and a matching light chain band on immunofixation.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has immunoblastic cells with very high proliferation and frequent EBER positivity, and usually expresses a light chain.
LPL comprises small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than a sheet of IgG-only plasmacytoid cells.
Non-secretory neoplasms lack both heavy and light chain secretion, whereas here an isolated gamma heavy chain band is detected.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD79a, CD138, IgG, kappa, lambda; IFE
